mutants.name: chain_dp_empty_box
mutants.desc: DP over decreasing chains where consecutive chain elements must have an EMPTY gap box (misses sets keeping balls in boxes)

mutants.name: chain_dp_no_canonical
mutants.desc: DP over decreasing chains (with sentinels) but without the canonicity check -> overcounts sets reachable via several chains

mutants.name: count_independent_sets
mutants.desc: counts independent sets C of the comparability graph (chosen sets) instead of distinct resulting sets V\N(C)

mutants.name: half_canonical_check
mutants.desc: reference DP but the canonicity check only looks for a dominating ball on the left side (ML), ignores the right side (MU)

mutants.name: unsorted_input
mutants.desc: reference DP but assumes positions are already given sorted by x (no sort)
